decisions.what: Changed updateDisplay() to no-param signature reading from state.currentNumber
decisions.why: Spec requires updateDisplay() to get display element by id and read currentNumber from state, not accept a value parameter

decisions.what: Updated all internal callers to set state.currentNumber before calling updateDisplay()
decisions.why: Required by new no-param updateDisplay signature; error display now sets state.currentNumber='Error' first

decisions.what: Added appendDigit(digit) with leading zero suppression and state reset logic
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires this function with isResultDisplayed/isErrorState checks and leading zero handling
Spec requires this function that returns early if '.' already in currentNumber

decisions.what: Added performCalculation() extracting calculation logic with error handling
decisions.why: Spec requires this function that calls calculate(), handles null (division by zero), updates currentNumber, clears storedNumber/pendingOperator, sets isResultDisplayed

decisions.what: Added setOperator(operator) with operator chaining support
decisions.why: Spec requires this function that calls performCalculation() when pendingOperator exists and currentNumber is non-empty, then stores operands and resets for next input

decisions.what: Kept existing handle* functions delegating to new append*/set* functions
decisions.why: Existing event listeners reference handleDigit/handleOperator/etc; keeping them avoids breaking the event wiring while the new named functions satisfy the spec
